Step: 1160 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not a century exception).  
09-01-1160 minus 57 days:  
31 days in August 1160 → back to 09-08-1160 (9 Aug) after 23 days (from 1 Sep).  
Remaining 34 days: July has 31 days, so back 31 days to 10-07-1160 (10 July).  
Then 3 more days back → 07-07-1160 (7 July).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1160-07-07
